1.2 Objectives of the Capacity Building Project
1. To strengthen the strategic capacity of prospective Hosting Organisations and their local
partners to improve their response to Humanitarian Aid crises.
2. To strengthen the organizational and technical capacity of prospective Hosting
Organisations and their local partners to respond to Humanitarian Aid crises.
3. To ensure overall consistency of the MdM Consortium for Capacity Building project,
between needs assessment, gaps identified and the implementation of the agreed activities,
according to the Work plan.
4. To raise awareness about UE Aid Volunteers Initiative and Humanitarian Aid towards
European civil society and the Third countries.

2. Evaluation purpose
The current evaluation is meant to be performed right before completion of the MdM Capacity
Building (Number; 593334) - EU Aid Volunteers. The main objective of this evaluation is to
assess to what extent the MdM Capacity Building-EU Aid Volunteers has contributed to
achieve the expected results. The evaluation should also analyse the project implementation
and the feasible sustainability. It is mainly concerned with assessing achieved impacts,
identifying and judging unexpected impacts and verifying the sustainability of the project's
benefits in the framework of the MdM Consortium.
The final product will be the conduct of the evaluation.
For the evaluation the purpose is twofold, focusing not only on the Project, but also on the
Partnership performance throughout the implementation of the specific Project activities.
The main users of these evaluations include MdM Spain staff, such as project managers,
operators in charge of the project conception, implementation, but also five MdM partners
from the MdM Capacity Building EU Aid Volunteers project to whom accountability is required
in the framework of the Project.
The MdM Consortium team hopes that this evaluation may help to make improved decisions,
to further articulate judgments on the development of future similar Capacity Building related
activities, as well as to better understand the effects of the Projects

3. Specific objectives
1. As MdM participates as a Consortium in the EU Aid Volunteers Initiative, and MdM-
Spain as Head of Consortium, it is relevant for us to evaluate: The EU Aid Volunteers
Initiative Capacity Building project implementation according to the Project Logical
framework, Work Plan and Budget and aligned with the EU regulations and EU-MdM
Grant Agreement.

2. Evaluate the MdM Capacity Building project Consortium management process
throughout the implementation of the Project, the external Consultancies and aligned
with the organization's volunteering policies.

3. Evaluate the MdM Capacity Building Consortium products and effects produced by the
project implementation.
